messages:
sarah (People Ops): Idea: a 24-hour 'Express Thanks' kiosk pilot in SF and NY lobbies on Aug 12. Tiny physical tokens (sticker + note) for on-the-spot recognition + instant e-thanks for remotes. Low lift, super visible. Thoughts?
diego (People Ops): Nice. Keeps momentum between bigger programs. What's rough cost per token?
anya (Office Ops): Stickers + printed 1-line cards ~ $0.90 each with local print shop. We can station 2 volunteers per shift for 3 hrs.
paul (Benefits): Quick tax check: sub-$50 non-cash token usually de minimis in US; e-thanks (non-monetary) fine. I'll confirm UK rules and post short note.
sarah (People Ops): Ops checklist: vendor quote by Mon, volunteer sign-up by next Wed, short manager note + nomination box on kiosk, e-thanks email template. Diego take vendor? Anya run volunteers? Paul post tax blurb?
diego (People Ops): I got vendor. Will share quote by Monday.
anya (Office Ops): I'll create a signup and packing plan. Two lobbies OK? need badge table and tape.
paul (Benefits): I'll confirm tax for UK by Tue and paste blurb.
kudos-bot: Reminder set: create calendar event "Express Thanks Kiosk" 2027-08-12.
sarah (People Ops): If all owners confirmed, pilot go-live Aug 12. Low friction, high smile. :smile:
